action_context_hypothesised_benefit: IPOTESI: use Ro 25-6981 as the second tool of the ifenprodil site in the neuron-specific Wwox-deleted juvenile slice, to ask whether a GluN2B amino-terminal-domain negative allosteric modulator of a different molecule removes the same measured percent of the isolated NMDAR current as ifenprodil; competing explanations kept: GluN2B-diheteromer versus triheteromer weighting, tonic Zn2+, a second molecule's own off-target action, state and recording condition.
compound_or_probe: Ro 25-6981 (GluN2B amino-terminal-domain negative allosteric modulator, phenylethanolamine class)
identity_status: resolved as a name: Ro 25-6981 is the same chemical name in the two papers that print it (maleate in Hedegaard 2012; hydrochloride in Chamberlain 2008; Zhu, Lee, Lu and the 2008 binding paper give no salt); the salt differs between papers, so a nominal concentration is not a molar equivalent across them (INFERENZA); supplier or lot not carried across papers.
documented_action_and_limits: DATO (text read): potency on GluN1/GluN2B oocyte diheteromers IC50 0.049 uM (human) and 0.042 uM (rat) at -40 mV, 30 uM glycine, pH 7.4, EDTA (D01, D02); 59 nM at pH 7.3 and 50 uM glycine against ifenprodil 105 nM in one experiment (D04); less than 20 percent inhibition at 100 uM on GluN1/GluN2A, 2C and 2D (D03, a single concentration); binding site at the GluN1/GluN2B ATD interface by crystal and cryo-EM structures (D10) and in the triheteromer structure the same pocket at the GluN1/GluN2B interface with the GluN2B ATD closing (D09); binding to the purified triheteromer is retained, submicromolar and about 3-fold weaker than the diheteromer, number not read (D08). Native slice: 500 nM removed about 93 percent of the isolated NMDAR EPSC amplitude in rat entorhinal layer V (read from a bar chart, D11). LIMITS: no fitted maximal inhibition for any composition; no functional IC50 or maximum on a triheteromer in a text read (D14); recombinant potency was measured without Mg2+ and with Zn2+ chelated; composition of the native receptors is inferred by the authors, not measured.
functional_comparison: INFERENZA: against ifenprodil, the two molecules share the GluN1/GluN2B ATD pocket and a similar potency order in the same experiments (59 versus 105 nM, rat oocytes; 60 versus 103 nM, chicken culture), so a second tool of the same site controls for chemotype and for the molecule's own off-target action but not for diheteromer versus triheteromer weighting: the recombinant ceiling for ifenprodil on triheteromers (earlier package) has no Ro 25-6981 counterpart in any text read. DATO that matters for design: the native entorhinal result (about 93 percent at 500 nM) is far above the 32 percent triheteromer ceiling of ifenprodil on recombinant triheteromers, which this package does not transfer to Ro 25-6981 and does not explain (differences in compound, Zn2+, Mg2+, presynaptic release and composition remain). [V3 correction: 'a different ceiling ... not a composition result' is too strong: the chicken-culture plateaus differ (about 70 versus 82 percent) and the Ro and ifenprodil affinity shifts on the triheteromer differ (about 3-fold versus 1.8-fold); neither is a functional maximum on triheteromers]
mechanism_discriminating_control: IPOTESI: the control that separates the explanations is a same-preparation, same-day pair: Ro 25-6981 and ifenprodil each at a saturating concentration on the isolated NMDAR current, with and without a Zn2+ chelator, expressed as percent of the current removed; coincident curves would be consistent with one pharmacological population and a different ceiling for one of them would indicate a molecule-specific action, not a composition result (INFERENZA).
measurement_that_makes_it_interpretable: M-R1 (new_measurements.tsv): percent of the isolated NMDAR current removed by Ro 25-6981 and by ifenprodil, each at a stated saturating concentration, in the Wwox slice with measured Mg2+, K+, temperature, and a Zn2+ chelator arm, against vehicle and time-matched controls. M-R2 (conditional): Ro 25-6981 and ifenprodil maxima on tagged GluN1/GluN2A/GluN2B versus GluN1/GluN2B in one oocyte series, only if a reading of the retention-signal paper and the Hansen supplement does not already give them.
outcome_favourable: IPOTESI: Ro 25-6981 and ifenprodil remove the same percent of the isolated current in the Wwox slice at saturation: consistent with one GluN2B-ATD population, and a second molecule adds no new information beyond chemotype control.
outcome_contrary: IPOTESI: Ro 25-6981 removes a clearly different percent than ifenprodil at equivalent occupancy: a molecule-specific action (Zn2+, release, off-target) or a different efficacy on a composition, not separated by this pair alone.
outcome_unresolved: IPOTESI: both remove a small percent: consistent with a triheteromer-weighted population or a small GluN2B-sensitive fraction, and also with tonic Zn2+ or state; with the recombinant ceilings not available for Ro 25-6981 the interpretation stays open.
explanations_not_separated: diheteromer versus triheteromer weighting; tonic Zn2+ (raises the removable fraction of ifenprodil and CP-101,606 on triheteromers in the earlier reading, not measured for Ro 25-6981); presynaptic versus postsynaptic NR2B contribution to an evoked amplitude (shown in Chamberlain 2008); salt and nominal concentration; bath and tissue pH; a purified-protein binding number against a current number.
